question: Which two freedom fighters threw smoke bombs at the Delhi Central Legislative Assembly in 1929?

options.text: Bhagat Singh and Subhash Chandra Bose

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw the bombs inside the Central Assembly in Delhi on April 8, 1929.
 
• The purpose of the bombing was to protest against the repressive laws and to garner attention for the cause of Indian independence.
 
• They deliberately chose not to flee the scene and instead courted arrest to use their trial as a platform to propagate their revolutionary ideas.
